task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York, look up the status of AA100, and if it’s on time then book AA100 in business class for Jordan Lee. Then get the details for Hilton Tokyo and prepare an availability request for a deluxe room for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-16 to 2026-01-18, and after that find meeting rooms for 8 people on 2026-02-22 at 09:00, shortlist the suitable options, get the room ticket details, and archive the ticket for Meeting Room 1 as “Meeting Room Archive” for user_01 by email with medium priority. Then back up /workspace/travel_ops as travel_meeting_plan_backup, create a snapshot report titled “Travel and Meeting Preparation Snapshot” for user_01 by email with medium priority, and send Jordan Lee an email alert with the backup details.

user_input.query: Please check the current time in America/New_York and look up the status of flight AA100. If AA100 is on time, book it in business class for Jordan Lee. Then get the details for Hilton Tokyo and prepare an availability request for a deluxe room for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-16 to 2026-01-18. After that, find meeting rooms for 8 attendees on 2026-02-22 at 09:00, shortlist the suitable options, get the room ticket details, and archive the ticket for Meeting Room 1 as “Meeting Room Archive” for user_01 by email with medium priority. Finally, back up /workspace/travel_ops as travel_meeting_plan_backup, create a snapshot report titled “Travel and Meeting Preparation Snapshot” for user_01 by email with medium priority, and send Jordan Lee an email alert with the backup details.
